coverage.note: Nine cases passed in the full run. Only natural Mulliboom was retried after screenshot timing and first-sample movement accounting corrections. Production native/WASM mechanics were unchanged. Two extra delayed-death visual captures passed separately.

limits: Existing generic silhouettes are retained; source eye and appearance animation fidelity remains open.
Rapid Mulliboom death can precede camera settling. Early native/browser captures are retained with that limitation.
DisplayedFPS is not a controlled performance benchmark; no FPS acceptance claim.

adaptations: Source HP and monster blast damage multiplied by 3.2; all bodies have 41.6 HP. Source distances multiply by .1; native 30 Hz projectile velocity multiplies by 3 for local units/second. Collision radii .6/.65 remain local geometry.
Source player half-heart/full-heart blast damage maps to 10/20 local damage before existing EnemyDamageMultiplier1.25. Player defaults remain unchanged.
Source flee/wander/chase forces and friction use 30 Hz updates with physical canyon navigation and body avoidance. No source rectangular grid imported.

Death blasts/shots/bombs are admitted together or retained until runtime capacity returns. Pending death payload keeps room sealed. An admitted Troll Bomb persists after producer removal and room clear.
Mulligan four-child count models the zero-initialized native NPC+bc6 counter. Existing bounded offspring generation and safe placement retry remain.
Troll Bomb initialized count45+RNG%30 maps provisionally to a1.5..74/30-second fuse. This is not verified native appearance-animation timing.
Normal-mode projectile speed7 is used; native hard-mode speed10 remains future difficulty support.

Local sparse pursuit weights, threat costs and caps map reviewed source stages into canyon bands; they are balance choices. Band0 Mulligan gets9.49%Mulligoon phase0 then1%Mulliboom phase1; standard band1 has a direct Mulliboom route.
